title: [ MZ ] Stop Textbox from holding the game

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
Hi all,
is there any way to tell a specific textbox message, not to hold the game in MZ?
What I mean is:
* you can't move with a textbox open
* you can't open a menu
* you can't trigger "On Hero Touch" events
* etc.
I have some passive textboxes that appear above the heads of your party members. Your party members chitchat randomly from time to time.
But the player shouldn't be affected by that.
I made a plugin working that allows you to continue walking while the textbox is open. But I can't figure out everything else (HeroTouch, Menu, etc).
So ... Is there a way to tell a textbox, not to pause everything?
Thank you!

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
@Zia_
- I found this small plugin by triacontane:
RPGMakerMV/MessageUnlockBusy.js at mz_master · triacontane/RPGMakerMV
RPGツクールMV、MZで動作するプラグインです。. Contribute to triacontane/RPGMakerMV development by creating an account on GitHub.
github.com
Basically, try using
\UL
in relevant Show Text commands? Looks like it just changes the interpreter wait mode, so I think Show Text commands will still have to wait for the message to be free. That's one reason many plugins for non-interrupting-messages (a.k.a. "gabs") define their own window for it.
@AquaEcho
- for something like that I'd instead suggest editing the
isParallel
function in my plugin code, to add a check for the chosen switch, e.g.
JavaScript:
const isParallel = function(interpreter) {
        return SceneManager._scene instanceof Scene_Map
            && interpreter !== $gameMap._interpreter
            && $gameSwitches.value(123);    // added
    };
That's the function my plugin uses to decide how to handle each Show Text command.
